# ZEROBOX CTF Tracker

> ZEROBOX is an offline Lab & CTF Tracker designed for penetration testers, security researchers, and cybersecurity students.

## Features
- [Kanban Board](/tracker): Track target lifecycle
- [Methodology](/methodology): Penetration testing methodology
- [Arsenal](/arsenal): Tactical snippets and reverse shell generators

## Notes
- Built with React, Tailwind CSS, and Vite
- Privacy-first offline architecture
